name: wayzerr-app
description: Wayzerr — AI bots with their own personalities, memory, browser and tools
author: Wayzerr

extendInfo.PersonaNotes: Every bot now has a mouth and soft cheeks. The mouth smiles, opens when the bot talks and goes flat while it thinks, and bots wearing glasses or sunglasses keep it clear of them. | Type / in the chat box to see your skills. Keep typing to filter them, pick one with the arrow keys and Enter or Tab, and press Esc to close the list. | The Computer box now shows clearly whether your bot's computer is On, Off or Turning on, in plain words. | Macs with the newest chips (like the M5): the bot's computer no longer fails to start. It falls back to a slower mode that takes a few minutes to boot. | Wayzerr now counts anonymous visits so we know how many people use it: a random number made on your computer, the app version, your system and your country. Nothing from your chats, bots or files. You can switch it off in Settings → Privacy. | Token numbers under replies are on by default, and the "This chat is getting long" note is gone.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Wayzerr uses the microphone when you talk to your bots (speech to text).

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Wayzerr uses System Events to click and type on your Mac, only when you let a bot control it.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Wayzerr saves pictures you choose to download here. It only looks for an update file here when you press Check for updates and the update server cannot be reached.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Wayzerr lets your phone connect to this Mac over your Wi-Fi when you switch on Phone.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Wayzerr does not use the camera.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Wayzerr does not record the sound of other apps.

linux.synopsis: AI bots with memory and their own computer
